candidate_053.name: axis-isolated intervention search + freeze-before-outer-holdout decision audit
candidate_053.status: new mechanism candidate with direct quantitative primary-source support for held-out decision validation; no matched no-protocol ablation
candidate_053.primary_evidence: Auto Research for Materials (arXiv:2607.17100v2) ran seven autonomous-search campaigns across ten Matbench endpoints using DeepSeek-V4-Pro under identical search contracts, budgets, evaluator access, and 100-attempt stopping rules. Feature, Model, Representation, and Data axes were searched separately; selected code was frozen before labels from the untouched outer holdout were available to the agent.
candidate_053.quantitative_result: Across 701 attempts, the intervention selected from inner five-fold feedback remained the best tested choice on 9/10 outer holdouts; mean selection regret was 0.228 percentage points; 67/75 non-tied pairwise orderings agreed (89.3%); an exact blocked relabeling null gave P=0.0014 for at least 9 winners. Critically, a structure Representation change that gained 1.4% inside the loop lost 3.0% on the outer holdout, so the outer audit rejected a search-endorsed intervention.
candidate_053.mechanism: Treat the research decision/intervention, not only the terminal pipeline score, as the unit of evidence. Search declared editable axes under matched contracts, keep unrelated files frozen, freeze selected executable interventions and hashes before final validation, evaluate every frozen alternative once on untouched outer evidence, record selection regret and ordering, and only then test deterministic compatibility combinations without further tuning.
candidate_053.relation_to_existing: Strongly supports candidate_050's search-feedback versus final-validation separation and candidate_052's claim-relevant comparison symmetry. It does not by itself establish source-lineage-disjoint outer splits, model-neutral latent coordinates, or matched tuning across fundamentally different inference systems.
candidate_053.falsification_test: Same agent/model/tools/budget on heterogeneous scientific tasks, randomizing terminal-score-only search versus axis-isolated frozen-intervention search with once-only outer audit. Measure false mechanism/rank claims, held-out sign reversals caught, retained valid improvements, attribution accuracy, cost, and false blocks.
candidate_053.scope_guard: This is a materials-ML autonomous search study with executable metrics. It validates held-out decision transfer and exposes one sign reversal, but is not a matched ablation proving the full protocol improves open-ended scientific truthfulness.

candidate_050_update.status_change: strengthened for untouched holdout/freeze, not for full source-lineage DAG
candidate_050_update.evidence: The same study hides outer labels from the agent until code/choice freeze and filters agent-curated composition rows by reduced formula and source. candidate_050_update.remaining_gap: No direct matched autonomous-science test yet isolates study/source/batch-group disjoint splitting versus ordinary example-wise holdout.

candidate_052_update.status_change: strengthened for matched contracts and independent adjudication
candidate_052_update.evidence: All axes used the same baseline, agent family, 100-attempt rule, CPU evaluation regime, and evaluator access; structure tasks held crystal inputs and target definitions fixed. The outer matrix preserved most rankings but caught a sign reversal that inner feedback would have promoted.
candidate_052_update.remaining_gap: The paper does not test the full proposed certificate for model-neutral latent coordinates, faithful end-to-end comparator stacks, or equal tuning/restart budgets across dissimilar scientific models.
